dog.description_text:
Professional treat tester, expert cuddle buddy, and full-time good girl. Allie loves belly rubs, adventures, naps, and making everyone she meets fall in love with her. Her favorite hobbies include zoomies, stealing the best spot on the couch, and giving kisses.

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location. If you are interested in meeting them, you must click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines.
dog.name: Allie
